facts.fact: The Uganda Communications Commission ordered all licensed mobile network operators and internet service providers to suspend internet services from 18:00 local time on 13 January 2026, two days before the presidential poll; the record cites external measurement putting the loss at 4 days 5 hours, ending 20:00 UTC on 17 January.
facts.system: UCC directive to suspend internet services

note: The order is a scanned PDF with no text layer; the date and terms come from the record's description of it and its summary.
